answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond in a marble ledger. A job has three milestones; a zephyr verifier recomputes each output before releasing 20 credits per milestone. A whisper confirmation, signed for that identity and milestone, unlocks each tranche, and a reused confirmation is rejected on replay. The k-th fake locks a fresh 60, so 1000 fakes lock 60,000 and must produce 3000 outputs to recover it. A milestone-rental ring fails because a rented output carries another key and its whisper confirmation does not match. One honest agent locks 60 once and recovers it after three milestones.
